import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    orders = inputs["orders"].copy()
    ref_customers = inputs["ref_customers"].copy()
    ref_skus = inputs["ref_skus"].copy()
    
    # Initialize result columns
    orders["_reason_code"] = None
    orders["_failed"] = False
    
    # R1: customer_id not present in ref_customers
    valid_customers = set(ref_customers["customer_id"].dropna().unique())
    r1_fail = ~orders["customer_id"].isin(valid_customers)
    orders.loc[r1_fail & ~orders["_failed"], "_reason_code"] = "CUST_UNKNOWN"
    orders.loc[r1_fail & ~orders["_failed"], "_failed"] = True
    
    # R2: customer status <> 'ACTIVE'
    # Merge to get customer status
    cust_status = ref_customers[["customer_id", "status"]].copy()
    orders = orders.merge(cust_status, on="customer_id", how="left")
    r2_fail = (orders["status"] != "ACTIVE") & ~orders["_failed"]
    orders.loc[r2_fail, "_reason_code"] = "CUST_INACTIVE"
    orders.loc[r2_fail, "_failed"] = True
    orders = orders.drop(columns=["status"])
    
    # R3: sku not present in ref_skus
    valid_skus = set(ref_skus["sku"].dropna().unique())
    r3_fail = ~orders["sku"].isin(valid_skus) & ~orders["_failed"]
    orders.loc[r3_fail, "_reason_code"] = "SKU_UNKNOWN"
    orders.loc[r3_fail, "_failed"] = True
    
    # R4: sku discontinued = 1
    sku_info = ref_skus[["sku", "discontinued", "allowed_countries"]].copy()
    orders = orders.merge(sku_info, on="sku", how="left")
    r4_fail = (orders["discontinued"] == 1) & ~orders["_failed"]
    orders.loc[r4_fail, "_reason_code"] = "SKU_DISC"
    orders.loc[r4_fail, "_failed"] = True
    
    # R5: allowed_countries non-empty AND ship_country not in delimited list
    def check_country_allowed(row):
        if row["_failed"]:
            return False
        
        allowed_str = row["allowed_countries"]
        # Empty or NULL means all countries allowed
        if pd.isna(allowed_str) or allowed_str == "":
            return False
        
        # Parse comma-delimited list with trimmed members
        allowed_list = [c.strip() for c in str(allowed_str).split(",")]
        ship_country = row["ship_country"]
        
        if pd.isna(ship_country):
            return True  # NULL ship_country fails the check
        
        return ship_country not in allowed_list
    
    r5_fail = orders.apply(check_country_allowed, axis=1)
    orders.loc[r5_fail, "_reason_code"] = "CTRY_BLOCKED"
    orders.loc[r5_fail, "_failed"] = True
    
    # Split into clean and rejects
    orders_clean = orders[~orders["_failed"]].drop(
        columns=["_reason_code", "_failed", "discontinued", "allowed_countries"]
    )
    orders_rejects = orders[orders["_failed"]][
        ["order_id", "customer_id", "sku", "qty", "ship_country", "_reason_code"]
    ].copy()
    orders_rejects = orders_rejects.rename(columns={"_reason_code": "reason_code"})
    
    return {
        "orders_clean": orders_clean,
        "orders_rejects": orders_rejects
    }
